entry.title: About Me
entry.content: Personal Info Name: Zhen-Hua Feng Gender: Male City: Dezhou City, Shandong Province, China Career: Teacher of refrigeration in QiMo College (2010.06-2011.04) Physics Teacher at Pingyuan County No. 1 Middle School（2011.04-2022.09) Postgraduate Student (2022.09-2025.06) Physics Teacher at Zibo Experimental High School (2025.08-) Education: DeZhou University | Beijing Normal University Primary Email: fengzhenhua@outlook.com fengzhenhua@mail.bnu.edu.cn fengzhenhua@sina.cn Secondary Email: fungzhenhua@outlook.com , fongzhenhua@outlook.com fungzhenhua@163.com , fongzhenhua@163.com fungzhenhua@sina.com , fongzhenhua@sina.com Article: Stability range of parameters at fixed points for a class of complex dynamics Comment on “Time crystals made of electron-positron pairs” Hobbies: Computer Science, LaTeX, VBA, Python, Physics, Motorbike Riding, Driving, Arch Linux My Links (2021): https://github.com/fungzhenhua (2021): https://github.com/fongzhenhua (2021): https://gitee.com/fengzhenhua Project diary.sh xugit.sh neogit.sh ugit.h archsetup.sh updatehost.sh ParuAxel.sh cexam.sty neovimconfig vimconfig dtx4code sfps separate-answers syndns.sh stirling.sh Blog description In 2022, I began using GitLab to write blogs, attracted by its fast access speed and flexibility. Some articles were directly migrated from Gitee due to the platform’s limitation of allowing only up to 35 published articles. By December 29, 2024, challenges with the mandatory migration to Jihu GitLab prompted my return to GitHub. To resolve the unavailability of the ‘fengzhenhua’ domain on GitHub, I launched my blog under the new domains ‘fungzhenhua’ and ‘fongzhenhua’. This transition not only solved the domain issue but also strengthened my presence within the GitHub community. My blog primarily focuses on computer-related topics, including using Linux for office tasks and programming with LaTeX, aimed at supporting scientific research. Please note that my work is provided free of charge.
